examples: Open a code for adding a second computer, read it on the first computer, type it on the second.
Stop a linked computer from controlling this one while this one still drives it.
Remove a computer you no longer use, from the computer that added it.
Add a second computer you can ssh into with keys: preview it, check the host key, approve, and it installs Carnivore and joins the pack.
how_to: On the new computer run curl -fsSL https://carnivore.ai/install.sh | bash (someone must be logged in there), then type the 6-digit code from main's invite card at the prompt, or paste the join link. Pressing enter alone sets it up as a separate computer.
Open pack, computers and press add a computer: the code (123 456), its countdown and the join link show on the invite card.
List the linked computers, their state and direction with computers_list.

Main must be awake with Carnivore open: it dials the new computer, so no port is opened and no router is changed. A code lives 15 minutes and 3 wrong tries; 10 wrong codes in an hour switch codes off for an hour.
On 1.16.0 a code join over the home network does not complete (pair over ssh, pack, ssh tab); the fix ships in the next release.
media_exempt: The panel needs a live computers link between two computers to show a code, a list and a job; the capture is recorded with the release end to end run.
name: Computers link
summary: add a computer with a short code or link over a direct encrypted link, see every linked computer, make one one way, remove it or leave the pack.
where: Pack, computers tab: add a computer, the invite card with the code and link, the list with a direction switch and remove, add over ssh, and join a pack on a standalone computer; agents use the computer tools.
